operator_selected_scope: Prepare and check the program only; block has not returned to A.
operator_gates_each_route: READY A: source loaded, destination empty, sheet/base/tool unchanged, raised route clear, hands/cables out
HELD: after a 10 mm local trial lift, visually confirm attachment
RELEASED: after pump off and a 10 mm local retract, visually confirm the block remains at the target
failure_policy: Stop and clear motion, preserve the current suction output, log stage and held-object assumption, never automatically retry or resume.
limitations: Model reachability and mock tests are not physical collision checking or vacuum sensing.
The high plane gives only nominal clearance for the approximately 25 mm blocks; actual obstacles must be checked onsite.
A must be replenished before each route; no conveyor or automatic material feeder is assumed.
The current block remains at D and the program is not armed. Return it to the original taught A before requesting execution.
